about: The Bought Parts, tools and consumables the maker buys (ADR 0092 decision 5). Every Bought Part of a schema 7 Design Contract names one id here; anything outside it needs the owner's approval, which is adding it here. Seeded for Night Charms Hall from its contract's purchased parts: every entry is unconfirmed, and its pack size and source are left empty until the owner supplies them. Sizes are the limits that contract states, not supplier data; each lamp's lead diameter is a seed guess, the diameter Make's lead-route gate sweeps (ADR 0092 decision 8), until the owner measures the real leads. The Macintosh fidget seeds (ADR 0095: cells, battery contacts, a lever microswitch, an amber LED, a resistor, hookup wire, an M2 x 6 door screw, solder and an iron) come from its locked spec (toys-spec/macintosh-fidget/NOTES.md, 2026-10-29): equally unconfirmed, their sizes the spec's nominal values and every lead diameter a seed guess. Its USB-C night light (owner, 2026-10-30) adds a power-only USB-C receptacle, a 2200 K 2835 warm-white LED and 150, 470 and 110 ohm resistors, all mounted on a factory-assembled PCBA that Make models as a mount; the buyer's USB charger is an external source and names no entry (ADR 0095 amendment). These are surface-mount, so they give no lead diameter. A part's optional model (ADR 0095 amendment, 2026-11-01) names the form bought_model.py draws it in from these sizes, and optionally a vendor STEP under models/ with its licence, URL and sha256, used only when it may ship with the toy; no vendor STEP is recorded yet. The synthwave arcade lamp (owner, 2026-11-03; toys-spec/synthwave-arcade-lamp/NOTES.md) adds a pink and a cyan 2835 LED for its sunset and grid light, with their LCSC supplier entries as sources; both stay unconfirmed until the owner confirms the real reel, and the cyan part was out of stock when added. The published R24 Synthwave Palm Bud Vase (owner, 2026-11-03; toys/rowan-vale-synthwave-palm-bud-vase) adds its water insert, a polypropylene test tube, with its supplier listing as its source and the supplier's pack of 250; it stays unconfirmed until a sample's outside diameter is measured. Every entry's unit_price_cents is an estimate (2026-11-06) of a small-shop Vietnamese retail price for one piece, or one pack (roll, spool, box) for consumables, converted at 25,780 VND per USD (Vietcombank sell rate, 2026-11-06); the listings behind each price are in docs/research/bought-part-prices-2026-11-06.md. The Amsterdam kit (owner, 2026-11-14; ADR 0104) adds the mini side nipper its box includes for cutting printed Parts off their sheet gates, at the owner's own estimate on the kit proposal page (about $1.50), not a supplier quote. It also adds the owner's packaging estimates of 2026-11-14 that a kit bills as extras: a printed Manual (about $1.20) and kit packing (about $0.50), and its two steel pin lengths, 1.5 x 20.6 (hinge, axle) and 1.5 x 4.3 (pivots, tips), bought at length so the buyer cuts nothing (leader, 2026-11-14), each priced like the 29.5 mm pin.
